invariants: Reaching the booking close below the minimum only marks the departure for review and never starts refunds without agency confirmation
A valid tourist cancellation atomically releases held or confirmed capacity and starts a full refund
A late or policy-disabled cancellation preserves the purchase and its capacity
Every refund deadline is exactly 72 hours after the refund request
A refund can be completed only after the tourist provides a valid QR or bank destination and the agency uploads proof of at most 5 MB
Only the purchase owner and assigned agency manager can read refund QR and proof images
Only the assigned agency manager can confirm a minimum shortfall or complete its refunds
